caveats: Recall is measured against synthetic injections plus one documented event; unlabeled real phenomena exist, so 'retained_unlabeled_rate' is an upper bound on the false-positive rate, not the rate itself.
science_value_per_mb_proxy = Σ(severity weight × assumed product fidelity) / downlinked MB. It is a proxy; it does not measure true scientific value.
When the engine is 'mock-heuristic-v1' the 'engine' rows describe a hand-written heuristic, not Jev. The heuristic and the injection generator were written by the same authors.
Byte costs are zlib sizes of PDS ASCII records; flight encodings would differ.
